hypotheses.S1_context_cancellation_is_concentrated: At least four base categories have positive split gain on both discovery halves.
hypotheses.S2_selected_splits_are_stable: At least half of the independently ranked top-eight category/scheme pairs agree.
hypotheses.S3_selective_context_beats_static_human: A selective grammar beats static human categories by 0.002 recovery at a matched budget on both evaluation halves.
hypotheses.S4_selective_context_is_more_efficient_t: A selective grammar beats its corresponding best fully crossed readable context program at the same budget on both halves.
